```{r}
# The easiest way to get ggplot2 is to install the whole tidyverse:

#DEGs in R1 vs other 
install.packages("tidyverse")

library(ggplot2)

down_blue = "#0377bd"
light_blue = "#81bbde"
up_red = "#c62828"
light_red = "#d15252"


df <- data.frame(genotype=c("4g4", "4g4", "R1", "R1"), change=c("up", "down", "up", "down"), value=c(217, 424, 627, 825))
df

p<-ggplot(data=df, aes(x=genotype, y=value, fill=change)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black", position=position_dodge()) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  ylab("Number of DEGs") + 
  ggtitle("Differentially expressed genes")

p + theme_classic() + scale_fill_manual(values=c(light_blue, light_red))

ggsave("DEGS 4g4 vs R1.png", width=3, height=3)



```
```{r}
genotypes<-c("1 4g4", "1 4g4", "4-1R0", "4-1R0", "4-2R0", "4-2R0", "4-2R1", "4-2R1", "4-3R0", "4-3R0", "4-4R0", "4-4R0", "4-4R1", "4-4R1")
change<-rep(c("gain", "loss"), 7)
values<-c(7461, 1295, 8148, 1539, 6048, 1730, 7995, 1835, 7233, 2300, 8040, 1618, 8480, 1583)

df<-data.frame(genotypes, change, values)
df

purple0 = "#f3e5f5"
purple1 = "#e1bee7"
purple2 = "#ce93d8"
p<-ggplot(data=df, aes(x=genotypes, y=values, fill=change)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black", position=position_dodge()) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  ggtitle("DMRs in different regenerants (CG)") + 
  ylab("Number of DMRs")

p + theme_classic() + scale_fill_manual(values=c(sage1, yellow1))

ggsave("gain_loss_DMRs_filtered.png", width=5, height=3)
```

```{r}
#hypocotyl regeneration to SIM direct, data as of 4/l6/24

genotypes <- c("a DRDD", rep(c("b dme"), 3), rep(c("c rdd"), 4), rep(c("d drdd"), 4))
values <- c(0, .2, 0, .02, .33, .063, .069, 0, .25, .054, .098, 0)
values <- values*100
df <- data.frame(genotypes, values)
df

p<-ggplot(data=df, aes(x=genotypes, y=values, fill=genotypes))  + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 60)) +
  stat_summary(aes(y = values), 
               fun = "mean", geom = "bar", fill = teal0, color = teal5) + 
  stat_summary(geom = "errorbar", color = teal5, width = .1) + 
  geom_point(stat="identity", show.legend = FALSE, size = .5) + 
  ylab("Percent of hypocotyls \nwhich regenerated a shoot") + 
  ggtitle("Hypocotyl regeneration \non direct transfer to SIM") 

p + theme_classic() 

ggsave("hyp direct sim.png", width = 3, height = 3)

#+ scale_fill_manual(values=c(purple2, purple0))



```


```{r}
#looking at all contexts? 

genotypes <- c(rep(c("preR"), 6), rep(c("4-1R0"), 6))
values <- c(7461,	1295,	4339,	775,	1000,	915, 8148,	1539,	7849,	767,	13126, 261)
change <- c(rep(c("gain", "loss"),6))
context <- c(rep(c("CG", "CG", "CHG","CHG", "CHH", "CHH"),2))
df<- data.frame(genotypes, values, change, context)
df


p <- ggplot(data=df, aes(x=genotypes, y=values, fill=context)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge())

p + theme_classic()


```
